svg.title: Snapshot file format: FileHeader, session count and sessionWithTimeOut entries
svg.desc: The article's original screenshot of parsed snapshot sessions could not be recovered; this is the author's own diagram of the snapshot file format (header and session section) from the same series of notes, with labels translated to English.
